title: GenAI model router
headline: Not every question needs the most expensive model: decide which one in milliseconds.
context: Generative AI gateway of a travel, hotel and energy company. Before calling a model, the router decides who should handle each request from customers and employees.

criteria.faq: Predefined answer: greeting or frequently asked question whose answer is already published (hours, policies, hotel services, contact details).
criteria.modelo_pequeno: Small model: simple, narrowly scoped task: translating, correcting or summarizing a short text, or looking up a specific customer data point (status of a booking, a payment or a refund).
criteria.modelo_grande: Large model: complex reasoning, analysis of several documents, planning, code or long-form writing.
criteria.humano: Human agent: emergency, serious complaint, decision with legal or financial impact, or an explicit request to talk to an agent.

datos_internos.instructions: Does it require looking up internal company or customer data (bookings, payments, contracts, reports, CRM)? Public hotel information (hours, services, policies) doesn't count.

datos_personales.instructions: Does it contain sensitive personal data (health, identity documents, bank details)?

items.text: Translate this message into Spanish for a customer: "Your transfer is confirmed for tomorrow at 9:00 a.m. at the main entrance".
Analyze these three laundry supplier proposals and recommend one, taking into account the total cost over 3 years, the SLAs and the contractual risks.
I want to talk to a person. You've overcharged me €1,200 and nobody is answering me. This is a disgrace.
What is the cancellation policy for the non-refundable rate?
Summarize this email in three bullet points: "Hi, we arrive on Friday at 23:00, we need a crib and a room far from the elevator. Thanks."
Design me a 10-day itinerary through Japan for a family with two kids and a budget of €8,000, combining bullet trains and domestic flights.
Write a Python script that calculates the average occupancy per hotel from a CSV and detects anomalies week by week.
Correct the spelling: "Please note that breakfast is sirved from 7 to 10 in the main restaurent."
My daughter has had a severe allergic reaction at the hotel restaurant and we're at the hospital. I need help now.
Compare sales for the last 4 quarters by channel and explain to me, using the attached reports, why the B2B channel is dropping.

notes.reto: Sending everything to the most powerful model is the easy option, but it makes cost and latency skyrocket. Most requests are greetings, FAQs or simple tasks that don't need it.
notes.solucion: Before each call, Decision-1 decides the route (FAQ, small model, large model or human agent), the complexity, and whether internal data is needed or sensitive data is involved, in about 300 ms and for a fraction of a cent.
notes.paradigma: The router costs less than what it saves on a single misrouted request. It is real-time AI FinOps: LLM spend drops by half or more without touching the applications. The same pattern picks the skill of an AI agent (the “Skill picker” template in the lab).
